messages:
anya: Quick readout from today's pricing page test. Calculator area shows heavy dwell but low CTA conversions. Heatmap: https://redwood-internal/hm/521345. Idea: add a lightweight 'Cost Lab' microflow that invites users to either paste a tiny workload sample (JSON/CSV) or join a 20-min office hours. Capture intent and route.

mara: Metrics pls?

anya: Calc impressions 2.9k, CTA CTR 1.3%, hover-to-click ~14:1, median dwell 3.2s. Repeat hovers common.

mara: Love the Cost Lab name. Two micropaths: A) Paste sample -> client-side parse -> preview estimate -> optional save (email + size). B) Reserve 20-min office hours slot. Both tiny forms.

ben: Routing idea: if saved_estimate && (company_size >= 120 || sample_rows >= 50) -> SDR queue 'costlab-fast' (24h SLA). If office_hours AND company_size >= 200 -> priority SDR. Else send to nurture. Tag leads with variant=costlab-v1 and sample_summary fields.

analytics-bot: Events needed: rw_costlab_show, rw_costlab_paste, rw_costlab_preview, rw_costlab_save, rw_costlab_reserve. Capture calc_session_id, sample_rows, avg_seq_len_bucket, utm. Prefill email when logged in.

mara: Microcopy sketches: Paste path header: "Paste a tiny workload sample (JSON/CSV) to get a tailored cost band" CTA "Preview my cost". Office hours: "20-min Cost Lab: practical tips for your workload" CTA "Reserve slot". Add a privacy note: "We only store your sample if you choose to save it."

anya: A/B test plan: Variant A = Cost Lab (paste + preview), Variant B = micro-modal (no paste, just reserve/workshop). Run 10 days. Primary metric = routed leads per 1k calc impressions; secondary = time-to-contact.

ben: I'll build HubSpot workflow, include calc_session_id and variant token, SLA 24h for costlab-fast. Template for SDRs will reference the saved preview.

analytics-bot: Will add a dashboard: funnel rw_costlab_show -> preview -> save -> routed. Reporting cadence: daily for 10 days.

mara: I'll produce final copy + two tiny templates (paste path, reserve path) by EOD. Also drop the short webinar blurb that maps to office hours (3 bullets: cost drivers, batching & quantization tips, deployment options).

anya: Great. Action items: mara copy + webinar blurb by EOD; ben HubSpot workflow + SLA by tomorrow; analytics-bot events + dashboard by tomorrow AM. We'll reconvene after 10 days with heatmap and funnel numbers. :rocket:
